content:
Amara will facilitate a small table conversation at Harbor Commons. The team
will bring anonymous summaries from the field day and open studio, explain the
sharing levels in [Consent and care for field notes](/note/notes/consent_and_care),
and ask what feels missing from the first Atlas draft.

Bring the [listening-session materials](/note/tasks/prepare_listening_session) and
leave room for feedback that does not fit a map.

occurrences.context: Sofia suggested carrying that same low-pressure feeling into the community listening session.
- [ ] Bring any unresolved questions to the community listening session.
After the open studio, the group is preparing a community listening session to decide which observations should shape the next public draft.

- [ ] Print a one-page version of the sharing levels - [ ] Turn three field observations into anonymous discussion cards - [ ] Reserve a quiet table and visible exit route - [ ] Confirm the facilitation plan with Amara - [ ] Add the outcome to the event note
